interpretation_boundary: The selected mixture was chosen using this swarm. Its held-out replay is a development diagnostic, not independent evidence. The scale ladder and future post-training panel remain separate tests.

content_hellinger_rbf_kernel.features: two 1,000-bin lexical distributions obtained by multiplying each phase's 200 cell weights by Marin's released cell-content basis
content_hellinger_rbf_kernel.gamma: 0.25 divided by the median positive training distance

hellinger_rbf_kernel.features: square roots of all 400 two-phase cell weights
hellinger_rbf_kernel.gamma: 0.25 divided by the median positive training distance

models.training_mean: per-target mean of the outer training fold

reproduction_contract.reason: dense linear algebra may differ slightly across BLAS implementations

split_contract.lineage_five_fold: interpolation check; identical mixtures stay together
split_contract.selected_pair: the published selected and baseline mixture lineages are both absent from training

status: retrospective development result; not a prospective claim
